title: Delivery moved later in a reply, US mm/dd date that is ambiguous (02/12/2027)
subject: RE: Urgent PO NGS-90214 joggers
body:
Karthik,

Thanks for flagging the fabric lead time. Our DC can take it later – new ex-factory 02/12/2027. Same quantities and price.

Derek
Northgate Sportswear LLC

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik <karthik@srivelanknits.example>
Sent: Monday, November 2, 2026
To: Derek Shaw
Subject: RE: Urgent PO NGS-90214 joggers

> Derek, with 42 days needed for fabric we cannot meet Dec 14, 2026. The earliest realistic ex-factory is early February.
